title: David attacks the Amalekites and rescues the captives
description: After the Amalekites had burned Ziklag and taken David's family, as well as the wives and children of his people, captive, David sought counsel from the Lord through the priest Abiathar and the ephod. With 400 men, he pursued the enemy, aided by a sick Egyptian slave they found in the field. David defeated the Amalekites, rescued all the captives and recovered all the plunder. He then established a law that the plunder should be shared equally between those who fought and those who stayed behind with the equipment. He also sent gifts to the elders of Judah.
